ctx.x: What was his name by the way, do you remember?

F.B. Robinson. Jim's brother. And I flew around a little while and I think you learned how to play pretty good you see. And I knew Sonny Henry, was a nice musician, and I went with him and I took, he started me out on the bass, on the bass horn and the fiddle, see. Then I went with Sam Morgan for True at that time, see. All the way. I was a Sam Morgan man from that time and Sam Morgan got, he did get crippled.
Sam Morgan was a little older than you I guess wasn't he?
